name: Kevin Merrix

tenures.role: wrestler — recently signed to the GWF, formerly of the WCIWA; BEW President Michael Merrix's own brother
tenures.source: the fed's own served Night of Armageddon broadcast (promotions/bew/archive/night-of-armageddon.html) and its own card page

notes: Wins the show's own untitled main event over Flesh with two Fallout finishers (a reverse Ligerbomb), then is beaten down after the bell by the M.o.A, gagged with Greg Eskridge's own jock strap by a turncoat Greg, and rescued in the show's own closing save by Vigilance, Chris Anderson, Brian Anderson, Richard Hope, and a freed Greg Eskridge.
caption: Won the show's own untitled main event over Flesh at Night of Armageddon (20 March 1999) — no title changed hands — before a post-match beatdown and a surprise save by his own former allies.

name: Michael Merrix

"Rage" is one of the hobby's most common ring names. This PWA wrestler is billed in full as "Brian 'The Rage' Andersen" on "Wednesday Night Chaos" and as "Rage I" on the fed's own Title History page — no evidence ties him to any of the bare "rage" rows minted for other, unrelated promotions. Presumed distinct.

Consolidated from the separately-minted the-rage-moa row, 2026-08-31 (coordinator-ruled under the merge-delegation doctrine, v93 — evidence past the Dan-Ryan bar). MoA's own roster bills this wrestler "The Rage - Brian Anderson" and narrates that he "joined the MoA when he turned on his former friend Sirus Moran"; this row is independently billed in full as "Brian 'The Rage' Andersen" on this fed's own broadcast, and this fed's own separately-served Sirus Moran bio card independently names "Rage" among the onetime allies who "turned heel on Sirus himself" — two independently-served documents from two different feds narrating the identical betrayal of the identical named third party, against a near-identical full billed name (a one-letter spelling variant). The moa row is retired; its own tenure is folded in above and its unit membership in the-masters-of-armageddon-moa is repointed to this id.
